content: this is a summary of a civil case in the alytaus district court the case involves the division of matrimonial property specifically an apartment and a vehicle the parties involved are not mentioned the court has ordered the applicant to compensate the defendant with a monetary amount of eur 8300 the applicant is seeking to annul their marriage establish the residence of their children and receive financial support for the children the defendant has the opportunity to respond to the application the court needs to decide on the division of jointly owned property and settlement of debts the applicant owns a portion of land and requests an apartment and a vehicle the value of the assets is eur 34300 and the debts amount to eur 17699 the defendant is entitled to eur 0 in assets and has debts of eur 8813 the court decides to award the apartment to the applicant and the defendant to receive a monetary compensation of eur 8300 the court has ordered the applicant to pay costs of eur 550 and the defendant to pay stamp duty and costs of serving procedural documents the court has annulled the marriage record assigned personal property rights to the applicant and ordered the defendant to pay compensation both parties will be jointly and severally liable in case of default on contractual obligations the defendant has also been ordered to pay the applicant for the costs of the proceedings and the stamp duty
